questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Please explain: *
Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: I study korean studies so it was very important for me to have more experience and a better understanding of the culture and being in the country

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: it was not very easy and the university was unclear in a lot of their information

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: i was offered and paid for a buddy from the visiting university but my application was not accepted due to last minute changes from their side and i therefore was not able to be assisted and had to find my own way around

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: What options were available for on campus housing? *
What options were available for meal plans or cooking facilities? *
What should future exchange students know about living in on campus housing? *
How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: at first i lived on campuss and got very ill due to the conditions of their housing as everything was moldy and dirty but i moved out after the first month and as i speak korean it was easier for me to find housing

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: it is easy to be scammed and you should bring a korean speaking person woith you

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: we had to use their website and as there were no instructions in english it made it very difficult to understand the process but i found a korean guide and was able to figure it out

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: none - you could email them but once the course regustration opened the courses were mostly already taken so you didnt have enough time to email them

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: i was pretty successful as i emailed the professors individually due to full quota

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: to look into and have the codes for the courses you are interested in ready for when the registration opens as it is a struggle to get the courses you want

questions.answer: BA

questions.answer: BA
